description: Add a statement to a deal as its buyer, up to 2000 characters. Free; needs the deal id, the buyer secret and the text. Statements are visible to the operator only.

deal_id.description: the deal id, as returned when the deal was created

secret.description: the buyer secret the buyer chose when creating the deal (agp_ and 32 hex)

name: add_statement
title: Add a statement
